articles.title: Heika’s Take: Clunky start, miscues doom Stars in season opener against Blues
Game Day Guide: Stars at Predators
Sharks Director of Hockey Operations Charlie Townsend promoted to Assistant General Manager, San Jose Barracuda

away.summary: The Sharks are 2-0-0 to start the season and project Yaroslav Askarov as the starting goalie. They will have a scratched lineup of Ty Dellandrea, Brett Leason, and Nolan Allan, with Adam Gaudette out due to an upper-body injury. Sam Dickinson is expected to make his season debut on defense after Allan played the first two games.

returning: : Joel Kiviranta (replacing Blackwell in the lineup)
home.summary: The Stars are 0-2-0 to start the season and project Jake Oettinger as the starting goalie. They will have a scratched lineup of Colin Blackwell and Kyle Capobianco, with Matt Duchene out due to a lower-body injury. Joel Kiviranta is returning to the lineup after Blackwell was a healthy scratch, and Mikko Rantanen is expected to play despite not taking part in the morning skate for maintenance.
